id: \bPaul: Hmph. I saw the Wallace Cup. I'm surprised you didn't use the opportunity to help your team grow with your love and trust.
en: \bPaul: Hmph. I saw the Wallace Cup. I'm surprised you didn't use the opportunity to help your team grow with your love and trust.
it: \bPaul: Pff. Ho visto la Coppa Adriano. Mi stupisce che tu non abbia approfittato dell'occasione per far crescere la tua squadra con il tuo amore e la tua fiducia.

id: \bI'd never waste my time like that. If you need to force your Pokémon to grow that's what you do, no matter the cost.
en: \bI'd never waste my time like that. If you need to force your Pokémon to grow that's what you do, no matter the cost.
it: \bIo non sprecherei mai il mio tempo così. Se devi costringere i tuoi Pokémon a crescere, lo fai e basta, a qualunque costo.

id: \bLet me see if your method has gained you any skill.
en: \bLet me see if your method has gained you any skill.
it: \bVediamo se il tuo metodo ti ha fatto guadagnare un po' di abilità.

id: \bPaul: You barely managed to scrape by. You're never going to make it with this kind of training.
en: \bPaul: You barely managed to scrape by. You're never going to make it with this kind of training.
it: \bPaul: Ce l'hai fatta per un pelo. Con questo tipo di allenamento non arriverai mai da nessuna parte.

id: \bI can't believe you wasted my time with that.
en: \bI can't believe you wasted my time with that.
it: \bNon posso credere che tu mi abbia fatto perdere tempo con questa roba.

id: \bSomeone swooped in and took my first Yanma. It was mean.
en: \bSomeone swooped in and took my first Yanma. It was mean.
it: \bQualcuno è piombato qui e mi ha soffiato il mio primo Yanma. Che cattiveria.

id: \rCan you take me to the water?
en: \rCan you take me to the water?

id: \bHave you ever had a Water type that you couldn't evolve? Well say goodbye to that!
en: \bHave you ever had a Water type that you couldn't evolve? Well say goodbye to that!
it: \bHai mai avuto un tipo Acqua che non riuscivi a far evolvere? Beh, dimentica quel problema!

id: \bA Water Stone can evolve a certain Pokémon for you. Enjoy it.
en: \bA Water Stone can evolve a certain Pokémon for you. Enjoy it.
it: \bUna Pietraidrica può far evolvere un certo Pokémon. Goditela.

id: \bIsn't it a great day for the beach?
en: \bIsn't it a great day for the beach?
it: \bNon è una giornata perfetta per andare in spiaggia?

id: \bI need to expand my team. That's why I fish.
en: \bI need to expand my team. That's why I fish.
it: \bDevo allargare la mia squadra. Per questo pesco.

id: \bI fish so my family will be well fed.
en: \bI fish so my family will be well fed.
it: \bPesco per dare da mangiare alla mia famiglia.
